source_refs.note: Exercise 14.1, Question 1: book page 266 (PDF 271); answer key PDF 311 (book page 306).

blocks.explanation:
Yeh sawal vectors ke simple hisaab ka hai: ek scalar multiple (vector ko kisi number se zarb dena) aur do additions.
Diya kya hai? Teen vectors \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\), \(\underline{w}\) apne components ke saath.
Find kya karna hai? Ek naya vector \(\underline{u} + 2\underline{v} + \underline{w}\).
Plan: pehle \(2\underline{v}\) banayenge, phir \(\underline{i}\) wale hisson ko \(\underline{i}\) se, \(\underline{j}\) wale ko \(\underline{j}\) se aur \(\underline{k}\) wale ko \(\underline{k}\) se jama karenge. Yaad rakhiye: alag directions ke components kabhi aapas mein nahi milte.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{u} = 3\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - 5\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} - 5\underline{j} - \underline{k}\) and \(\underline{w} = -4\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 7\underline{k}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\underline{u} + 2\underline{v} + \underline{w}\).
Tareeqa: Scalar multiplication mein vector ka har component us number se multiply hota hai, aur vector addition mein sirf milte julte components (same direction wale) jama hote hain.

\(2\underline{v}\) nikalein
\[2\underline{v} = 2(\underline{i} - 5\underline{j} - \underline{k})\]
\[= 2\underline{i} - 10\underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Vector ko 2 se multiply karne ka matlab hai har component ko 2 se multiply karna. Is se vector ki direction wohi rehti hai, sirf lambai (magnitude) double ho jati hai. Bracket khol kar har term ko alag alag 2 se zarb diya.

\(\underline{i}\) wale components jama karein
\[3 + 2 + (-4) = 1\]
Kyun: \(\underline{u}\) mein \(\underline{i}\) ka coefficient 3, \(2\underline{v}\) mein 2 aur \(\underline{w}\) mein \(-4\) hai. Sirf yahi teen numbers jama hote hain, kyunke \(\underline{i}\) x-axis ki direction hai aur dusri directions se is ka koi lena dena nahi.

\(\underline{j}\) wale components jama karein
\[2 + (-10) + (-1) = -9\]
Kyun: Wohi rule y-direction ke liye. Negative numbers ko bracket mein likhne se sign ki ghalti kam hoti hai: \(2 - 10 - 1 = -9\).

\(\underline{k}\) wale components jama karein
\[-5 + (-2) + 7 = 0\]
Kyun: Ab z-direction: \(-5 - 2 = -7\), phir \(-7 + 7 = 0\). Zero aana koi ghalti nahi; iska matlab hai ke natija vector z-direction mein bilkul nahi jata.

Natija likhein
\[\underline{u} + 2\underline{v} + \underline{w}\]
\[= \underline{i} - 9\underline{j} + 0\underline{k}\]
\[= \underline{i} - 9\underline{j}\]
Kyun: Teeno components jor kar vector likha. \(0\underline{k}\) likhne ki zaroorat nahi, kyunke zero ka koi asar nahi hota.

Tasdeeq (bracket form)
\[[3, 2, -5] + [2, -10, -2]\]
\[+ [-4, -1, 7] = [1, -9, 0]\]
Kyun: Vectors ko \([x, y, z]\) bracket form mein likh kar column ke hisaab se jama kiya, aur wohi jawab aaya. Do alag tareeqon se ek hi jawab aaye to hum mutmain ho sakte hain.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\underline{u} + 2\underline{v} + \underline{w} = \underline{i} - 9\underline{j}\)
Yani natija vector ka z-component zero hai, yeh xy-plane mein para hai.

blocks.explanation:
Is part mein pehle scalar multiple, phir subtraction (minus) hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\underline{v}\) aur \(\underline{w}\) ke components.
Find kya karna hai? Vector \(\underline{v} - 3\underline{w}\).
Plan: \(3\underline{w}\) banayenge, phir har component ko alag minus karenge. Subtraction mein sab se zyada ghaltiyan signs mein hoti hain, is liye har minus ko bracket ke saath likhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} - 5\underline{j} - \underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = -4\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 7\underline{k}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\underline{v} - 3\underline{w}\).
Tareeqa: \(\underline{v} - 3\underline{w}\) ka matlab hai \(\underline{v}\) mein \((-3)\underline{w}\) jama karna. Pehle \(\underline{w}\) ko 3 se multiply karenge, phir milte julte components ko minus karenge.

\(3\underline{w}\) nikalein
\[3\underline{w} = 3(-4\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 7\underline{k})\]
\[= -12\underline{i} - 3\underline{j} + 21\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Har component ko 3 se zarb diya: \(3 \times (-4) = -12\), \(3 \times (-1) = -3\), \(3 \times 7 = 21\). Sign wahi rehta hai jo andar tha, kyunke 3 positive hai.

\(\underline{i}\) components minus karein
\[1 - (-12) = 13\]
Kyun: \(\underline{v}\) ka \(\underline{i}\) component 1 hai aur \(3\underline{w}\) ka \(-12\). Minus aur minus mil kar plus bante hain, is liye \(1 + 12 = 13\).

\(\underline{j}\) components minus karein
\[-5 - (-3) = -2\]
Kyun: Yahan bhi negative ko minus kiya: \(-5 + 3 = -2\).
Dhyan dein: bohot se students yahan \(-5 - 3 = -8\) likh dete hain; bracket lagane se yeh ghalti nahi hoti.

\(\underline{k}\) components minus karein
\[-1 - 21 = -22\]
Kyun: \(-1\) mein se 21 aur kam kiya to \(-22\) bana. Dono negative taraf jaate hain, is liye jawab aur negative ho gaya.

Natija likhein
\[\underline{v} - 3\underline{w} = 13\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} - 22\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Teeno components ko unke unit vectors \(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\), \(\underline{k}\) ke saath jor diya.

Tasdeeq
\[(13\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} - 22\underline{k}) + 3\underline{w}\]
\[= \underline{i} - 5\underline{j} - \underline{k} = \underline{v} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Agar jawab sahi hai to us mein \(3\underline{w}\) wapas jama karne se \(\underline{v}\) milna chahiye: \(13 - 12 = 1\), \(-2 - 3 = -5\), \(-22 + 21 = -1\). Bilkul \(\underline{v}\) mil gaya, is liye jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\underline{v} - 3\underline{w} = 13\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} - 22\underline{k}\)
Subtraction mein har minus ko bracket ke saath likhna aadat bana lijiye.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan vector ke gird do seedhi lakeerein \(|\;|\) hain, jin ka matlab magnitude (lambai) hai. Magnitude ek number hota hai, vector nahi.
Diya kya hai? \(\underline{v}\) aur \(\underline{w}\).
Find kya karna hai? Pehle vector \(3\underline{v} + \underline{w}\), phir us ki lambai.
Plan: \(3\underline{v}\) banayein, \(\underline{w}\) jama karein, phir formula \(|x\underline{i} + y\underline{j} + z\underline{k}| = \sqrt{x^2 + y^2 + z^2}\) lagayein. Yeh formula Pythagoras theorem ka 3-D roop hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} - 5\underline{j} - \underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = -4\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 7\underline{k}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(|3\underline{v} + \underline{w}|\).
Tareeqa: Pehle andar wala vector poora banayenge, phir us ke components par magnitude ka formula lagayenge. \(|3\underline{v}| + |\underline{w}|\) alag alag le kar jama karna ghalat hoga.

\(3\underline{v}\) nikalein
\[3\underline{v} = 3\underline{i} - 15\underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{v}\) ke har component ko 3 se zarb diya: \(1 \to 3\), \(-5 \to -15\), \(-1 \to -3\).

\(\underline{w}\) jama karein
\[3\underline{v} + \underline{w}\]
\[= (3 - 4)\underline{i} + (-15 - 1)\underline{j}\]
\[\quad + (-3 + 7)\underline{k}\]
\[= -\underline{i} - 16\underline{j} + 4\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Milte julte components jama kiye: \(3 - 4 = -1\), \(-15 - 1 = -16\), \(-3 + 7 = 4\).

Magnitude ka formula lagayein
\[|3\underline{v} + \underline{w}| = \sqrt{(-1)^2 + (-16)^2 + 4^2}\]
\[= \sqrt{1 + 256 + 16}\]
\[= \sqrt{273}\]
Kyun: Kisi vector \(x\underline{i} + y\underline{j} + z\underline{k}\) ki lambai \(\sqrt{x^2 + y^2 + z^2}\) hoti hai; yeh Pythagoras theorem ko do dafa lagane se aata hai. Negative number ka square hamesha positive hota hai, is liye \((-16)^2 = 256\).
Dhyan dein: \(-16^2\) bina bracket likhein to calculator \(-256\) de dega; bracket zaroor lagayein.

Root ko simplify karein
\[273 = 3 \times 7 \times 13\]
Kyun: 273 ke factors mein koi bhi number do dafa nahi aata (koi perfect square factor nahi), is liye \(\sqrt{273}\) isi tarah rehta hai.

Tasdeeq (andaza)
\[16^2 = 256 < 273 < 289 = 17^2\]
Kyun: Lambai 16 aur 17 ke darmiyan (taqreeban 16.52) hai. Vector ka sab se bara component \(-16\) hai, aur lambai us se thori si zyada honi chahiye, so jawab mantaqi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(|3\underline{v} + \underline{w}| = \sqrt{273}\) (taqreeban 16.52)
Magnitude hamesha positive number hota hai.
